swegym_openhands.license_status: ambiguous (dataset card declares no license; companion repo SWE-Gym/SWE-Gym is Apache-2.0)

identity_model.deduplication: drop only true duplicates: same dataset and identical full-trajectory content hash (canonical events including label); counted as duplicates_dropped
identity_model.group_key: <dataset>:<instance_or_task_id> -- the shared task instance; same-instance trajectories never straddle partitions, so splits and prefix grouping MUST key on group_key
identity_model.parent_id: <dataset>:<instance_or_task_id>:<run_discriminator> -- one distinct parent run over the instance
identity_model.run_discriminator: <metadata.source_run_id>-<sha1[:10] of full canonical trajectory content hash (events incl. label)> when the source provides a per-run field, else the content hash alone; the content-hash component is mandatory because source run ids repeat across distinct runs of one instance

usability_rule: parent accepted iff terminal label defined (outcome.success is not None) AND outcome confidence >= 0.65
